shots.name: glow-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Glow card: the Preset menu showing Neon Bloom, Amount 4, Threshold 0.85, Softness 0.6, Radius 70 px and a white Color swatch, beside a strip of the preview where the neon signs bloom
shots.caption: Glow with the Neon Bloom preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Amount: how bright. 3 — Threshold: what glows. 4 — Softness: how gently light joins in. 5 — Radius: how far it spreads. 6 — Color: the tint of the halo.
